title: Directory listing exposes database backup
notes:
Directory listing is enabled on /backup/. The listing shows db_dump_2026-09-30.sql.gz (48 MB) and site_2026-09-30.zip.
I downloaded the SQL dump and confirmed that it contains the users table with hashed credentials.
